action.description: Runs a capability and waits for its result.

expressions.description: Fills null placeholders in arguments with expression results, keyed by JSON Pointer.

templates.description: Fills null placeholders in arguments with template text, keyed by JSON Pointer.

result.description: A declared variable that receives the capability's result, a map such as the items an inventory read gives.

condition.description: Tests a capability or an expression, then runs then or else.

expressions.description: Fills null placeholders in arguments with expression results, keyed by JSON Pointer.

templates.description: Fills null placeholders in arguments with template text, keyed by JSON Pointer.

expression.description: Tested instead of a capability; must be true or false.

then.description: Runs when the condition is true.

else.description: Runs when the condition is false.

wait.description: Waits a number of behavior ticks.

ticks.description: Behavior ticks, about 50 ms each: 1 to 72000, or an operand computed when the wait starts, held to 0 to 72000.

repeat.description: Runs its body a fixed or computed number of times.

count.description: How many times the body runs: 0 to 128, or an operand computed when the loop starts.

maximum.description: The most passes before the run fails; 128 by default.

index.description: An execution variable that receives the 0-based pass number.

foreach.description: Runs its body once for each item of a list or map.

list.description: An operand that evaluates to a list or map.

as.description: An execution variable that receives each item.

index.description: An execution variable that receives the 0-based pass number.

key.description: An execution variable that receives each map key.

maximum.description: The most passes before the run fails; 128 by default.

while.description: Runs its body while an expression is true.

expression.description: Checked before every pass; must be true or false.

maximum.description: The most passes before the run fails; 128 by default.

continue.description: Starts the next pass of the innermost loop.

parallel.description: Runs independent branches, then joins them.

call.description: Runs another routine of this behavior, optionally for another player or NPC.

routine.description: A routine of this behavior.

arguments.description: Declared variables assigned before the routine runs, each from a literal or operand.

result.description: A declared variable that receives the routine's return value.

player.description: A player UUID the routine runs for: its player facts, player flags and actions address that player.

npc.description: An NPC UUID the routine runs for: its NPC facts, NPC flags and actions address that NPC.

return.description: Ends the current routine, optionally with a value.

value.description: The value the routine returns to its call's result.
A literal of the variable's type, or an operand converted to it.

get.about: The item at a 0-based index of a list or a key of a map; without a fallback, a missing item fails.

has.about: Whether the map has the key.

put.about: A new map with the key set to the value.

remove.about: A new list or map without the item at that 0-based index or key.

append.about: A new list with the value added at the end.

insert.about: A new list with the value added at the 0-based index.

index_of.about: The 0-based index of the value in the list, or -1 when it is not there.

first.about: The first item of the list; an empty list fails.

last.about: The last item of the list; an empty list fails.

slice.about: The items or characters from the index from up to but not including the index to.

reverse.about: The list or text in reverse order.

sort.about: A list of only numbers or only text, in order.

sum.about: The total of a list of numbers.

join.about: The items as text with the separator between them.

split.about: The text cut at each separator.

range.about: The whole numbers from from to to, both included, at most 256.

trim.about: The text without spaces around it.

replace.about: The text with every find replaced by with.

starts_with.about: Whether the text starts with the prefix.

ends_with.about: Whether the text ends with the suffix.

num.about: A number from a number or numeric text; anything else fails.

truthy.about: True for true, the text true in any case, and numbers other than zero.

same.about: Equal as numbers when both are numbers or numeric text, otherwise equal as text ignoring case.

same_world.about: Whether both name the same world, each by its name, UUID or dimension key such as minecraft:the_nether.

random.about: A whole number from min to max, both included.

random_decimal.about: A number from 0 up to but not including 1.

pick.about: A random item of the list; an empty list fails.

flag.about: A flag of this behavior's namespace in the scope player, npc, relationship or global; without a fallback it must be set.

has_flag.about: Whether that flag of this behavior's namespace is set.

quest.about: A quest stage of this behavior's namespace, 0 when unset.

players.about: The player UUIDs in a list or a single value, in order and without repeats, at most 100.

player_info.about: Another online player's facts as a map with the player fact keys; an empty map when that player is offline.

player_flag.about: A player flag of this behavior's namespace for another player; without a fallback it must be set.

player_has_flag.about: Whether another player has that player flag of this behavior's namespace.

npcs.about: The UUIDs of every NPC the server knows, spawned or not, at most 1,024.

npc_info.about: An NPC's facts as a map with the npc fact keys; an empty map for anything that is no NPC.

npc_flag.about: An npc flag of this behavior's namespace for another NPC; without a fallback it must be set.

npc_has_flag.about: Whether another NPC has that npc flag of this behavior's namespace.

distance.about: The distance in blocks between two locations written x,y,z or x,y,z,world; locations in different worlds are 1,000,000,000 apart.

duration_seconds.about: The seconds in a number or in duration text such as 10m, 30t, 1h30m or d@1d.

duration_text.about: Seconds written as text such as 2h 30m, or 0s for none.

flag_expiry.about: When a flag of this behavior's namespace expires, in epoch milliseconds; 0 when it never expires or is unset.

player_flag_expiry.about: When another player's player flag of this behavior's namespace expires, in epoch milliseconds; 0 when it never expires or is unset.

type_of.about: The value's type: list, map, text, number or boolean.

has_player.about: Whether a player started the run; a command run from the console has none.

offset.about: The location moved by those blocks, written x,y,z,world to two decimals.

players_near.about: The UUIDs of the online players within radius blocks of the location in its world, nearest first, at most 100.

within.about: Whether the location is inside an area map with a world, a shape of cuboid or ellipsoid and six bounds.

now.about: The time now in epoch milliseconds, read as the expression runs.

player_named.about: The UUID of the online player with that name ignoring case, else the shortest name that starts with it, then one that contains it; empty text for none.

align.about: The text padded with spaces to width visible characters, where mode is left, center, middle or right.

alpha.about: The color with its alpha channel set to alpha, from 0 to 255.

argb.about: A color from four channels, each from 0 to 255.

bar.about: A progress bar width characters wide: filled text for the share value has of maximum, empty text for the rest.

ceil.about: The smallest whole number not below x.

clamp.about: x held between low and high.

contains.about: Whether the list holds the value, or the text contains it.

cos.about: The cosine of an angle in radians.

fixed.about: The number written with that many decimals, from 0 to 20.

flash.about: first on even steps and second on odd steps.

floor.about: The largest whole number not above x.

len.about: The number of items in the list or characters in the text.

lerp.about: The number t of the way from a to b; t is not held between 0 and 1.

marquee.about: The text scrolling left through a window of width characters, from 1 to 64.

max.about: The larger of the two numbers.

min.about: The smaller of the two numbers.

mix.about: A blend of two colors channel by channel, t of the way from the first to the second.

mod.about: What is left of a after taking away whole multiples of b, with the sign of b; b of 0 fails.

number.about: The number in a number or in formatted text, with color codes and thousands commas ignored.

odometer.about: The whole number progress of the way from from to to, padded with zeros to digits, from 1 to 16.

palette.about: The number at the index of the list, counting around past its end.

plain.about: The text without its & color codes.

pow.about: base raised to the power exponent.

readable.about: A key such as IRON_ORE written as Iron Ore.

rgb.about: An opaque color from three channels, each from 0 to 255.

round.about: x rounded to the nearest whole number, halves rounded up.

scanner.about: The text with one highlighted character moving across it a step at a time.

scramble.about: Random characters that settle into the text a step at a time.

select.about: The item at the index of the list, counting around past its end.

sin.about: The sine of an angle in radians.

smoothstep.about: A smooth step from 0 to 1 as x moves from edge0 to edge1.

timeline.about: The text of the scene showing after that many seconds of a looping list of [text, seconds] scenes.

typewriter.about: The text typed out, held for hold_steps and erased, a character a step.

wave.about: The text with a list of 1 to 16 color styles moving across its characters.

wipe.about: The text revealed and hidden a character a step, keeping its width.

factFormats.player.world: world name such as world_nether on Bukkit, dimension key such as minecraft:the_nether on mod servers
factFormats.player.item_in_hand: namespaced item id such as minecraft:wheat, minecraft:air for an empty hand
factFormats.npc.world: world name such as world_nether on Bukkit, dimension key such as minecraft:the_nether on mod servers
factFormats.npc.behaviors: list of behavior ids such as town:greeter
